title: Fresh blind fixed-dimension bottom-adjacent state-placement discriminator
scientific_question: At fixed total state dimension, does reallocating vertically aggregated state from higher parts of the column into progressively thinner bottom-adjacent layers materially improve high-resolution B14 dynamic prescribed-head fidelity under unchanged BC1 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE?

blind_design.history_design_note: Fresh exact initial states and switching schedules were fixed before any P01-P04 response. Head amplitudes retain the established C5A/C5N envelope to isolate placement.

target.interpretation: Finest available numerical control, not continuum truth.

reference_design.numerical_policy: exact pre-existing D13 integrated-water-depth Reference policy used by C5I/C5L/C5N
reference_design.profile_output: 16 fixed 10-cm water-content bins at each 0.0008-day observation window

representations.candidate_dt_authority: C5B established negligible CURRENT_LAYER_FACE timestep effect relative to representation error; C5P retains the frozen candidate dt.

B5.role: move one state from 130-140 cm to split bottom 10 cm into two 5-cm states

B2P5.role: concentrate all three nonbulk states within bottom 10 cm

B5.role: move one upper lower-zone state to split bottom 10 cm into two 5-cm states

B2P5.role: concentrate two states further into bottom 10 cm

design_origin.provenance: C5C pre-existing mechanism evidence showed strong B14 dynamic-head sensitivity when bottom support was refined from 10 to 5 to 2.5 cm.
design_origin.interpretation: Dyadic transfer levels are prospective diagnostic coordinates, not fitted optimal boundaries.

metric_views.profile: groundwater view plus mapped_theta_rmse across 16 fixed 10-cm bins
placement_diagnostics: componentwise D4_B5 versus D4_B10 groundwater comparison
componentwise D4_B2P5 versus D4_B5 and D4_B10 groundwater comparisons
componentwise D8_B5 versus D8_B10 groundwater comparison
componentwise D8_B2P5 versus D8_B5 and D8_B10 groundwater comparisons
continuous error ratios for every metric without scalar collapse
profile tradeoff reported separately from groundwater response

comparator_rules.high_resolution_spatial_frontier: Candidate is componentwise no worse than R1024_T16 relative to R2048_T16 on the declared view.
comparator_rules.temporal_floor: Candidate is componentwise no worse than R2048_T8 relative to R2048_T16 on the declared view; numerical diagnostic only.
comparator_rules.baseline_improvement: Focused candidate is componentwise no worse than the same-dimension B10 baseline on the groundwater view and has strictly smaller interval-bottom-flux RMSE by more than 1e-12.
comparator_rules.dyadic_progression: B2P5 componentwise no worse than B5 and B5 componentwise no worse than B10 on the groundwater view; reported as a hypothesis, not required for a useful continuous placement response.

reference_quality_interpretation.gate: R2048 T8-to-T16 must be componentwise no worse than R1024-to-R2048 on both groundwater and profile views before any C5P LARE response is generated.
reference_quality_interpretation.if_failed: Stop before candidate response and preserve the Reference-quality blocker.
reference_quality_interpretation.if_passed: Proceed with frozen D4/D8 placement families; R1024 crossing remains comparator-relative, not continuum or application acceptance.

hypotheses.H_D4_BOTTOM_FOCUS_IMPROVES: At least one D4 focused variant (B5 or B2P5) is componentwise no worse than D4_B10 on groundwater view and strictly lowers bottom-flux RMSE.
hypotheses.H_D8_BOTTOM_FOCUS_IMPROVES: At least one D8 focused variant (B5 or B2P5) is componentwise no worse than D8_B10 on groundwater view and strictly lowers bottom-flux RMSE.
hypotheses.H_D4_DYADIC_PROGRESS: D4_B2P5 is componentwise no worse than D4_B5, and D4_B5 no worse than D4_B10, on groundwater view.
hypotheses.H_D8_DYADIC_PROGRESS: D8_B2P5 is componentwise no worse than D8_B5, and D8_B5 no worse than D8_B10, on groundwater view.
hypotheses.H_ANY_FOCUSED_MEMBER_CROSSES_R1024_GW: At least one B5/B2P5 focused member crosses the R1024 groundwater comparator.
hypotheses.H_PROFILE_TRADEOFF: Groundwater improvement from bottom-focused redistribution need not imply mapped-profile improvement; both views are reported separately.

decision_logic.C5P_BOTTOM_FOCUS_RESCUES_HIGH_RES_GW_FRO: Reference gate passes and at least one focused member crosses R1024 on groundwater view.
decision_logic.C5P_BOTTOM_FOCUS_IMPROVES_BUT_NO_HIGH_RE: Reference gate passes, no focused member crosses R1024 GW, but at least one fixed-dimension family satisfies the baseline-improvement rule.
decision_logic.C5P_BOTTOM_FOCUS_NO_IMPROVEMENT_CLOSURE_: Reference gate passes and neither D4 nor D8 focused family satisfies baseline-improvement.
decision_logic.C5P_REFERENCE_OR_EXECUTION_BLOCKED: Reference quality, provenance, integrity, or fail-closed gate fails.

stop_rules: No C5P response-based adjustment of partition coordinates.
No new state count within C5P; dimensions are fixed at 4 and 8.
No new closure, scalar correction, history state or boundary counterfactual.
No application acceptance, performance, speedup or production-ROM claim.
If placement improves but no comparator frontier is reached, retain the continuous improvement result; do not invent an acceptance tolerance.
If placement does not improve, closure-family reconciliation is strengthened but still requires a separate prospective closure discriminator before implementation.

execution_plan.stage1: Generate fresh R1024_T16, R2048_T16 and R2048_T8 Reference controls on P01-P04 and qualify O0/O2, mass and temporal-quality gates.
execution_plan.stage2: Only after Reference qualification, execute six frozen fixed-dimension LARE candidates.
execution_plan.execution_partition: Reference routes may be split by history and compiler optimization only as execution topology.

implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: fresh P01-P04 Reference materialization, history-sliced execution, fixed-dimension D4/D8 bottom-placement candidates, and preregistered comparator-relative analysis
implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: response-driven partition changes, new closure terms, scalar tuning, boundary counterfactuals, production Reference edits
implementation_binding.binding_note: Workflow and all scientific implementation blobs bound before the authoritative C5P response run; any workflow-triggered pre-binding run is superseded by concurrency and is not scientific authority.
